parameters.subsql:
SELECT
    s.security_id,
    s.secid,
    sd.trade_date,

    sd.open,
    sd.high,
    sd.low,
    sd.close,
    sd.volume,
    sd.value,

    COALESCE(sf.split_factor, 1) as split_factor,

    (sd.open * COALESCE(sf.split_factor, 1))::numeric as open_adj,
    (sd.high * COALESCE(sf.split_factor, 1))::numeric as high_adj,
    (sd.low * COALESCE(sf.split_factor, 1))::numeric as low_adj,
    (sd.close * COALESCE(sf.split_factor, 1))::numeric as close_adj

FROM dwh.security as s

JOIN dwh.security_daily as sd
    on s.security_id = sd.security_id

LEFT JOIN analytics.v_split_factors as sf
    on s.security_id = sf.security_id
    AND (
        sf.date_from IS NULL
        OR sf.date_from <= sd.trade_date
    )
    AND sf.date_to > sd.trade_date

SELECT
    s.secid,
    d.registry_close_date,
    d.dividend_value,
    d.currency_code,
    CASE
        WHEN d.currency_code = 'RUB'
            THEN d.dividend_value
        ELSE d.dividend_value * cr.unit_rate
    END AS dividend_rub

FROM dwh.security AS s

JOIN dwh.dividend AS d
    ON d.security_id = s.security_id

LEFT JOIN dwh.currency AS cur
    ON d.currency_code = cur.iso_char_code

LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cr.unit_rate
    FROM dwh.currency_rate AS cr
    WHERE cr.currency_id = cur.currency_id
      AND cr.rate_date <= d.registry_close_date
    ORDER BY cr.rate_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS cr ON TRUE

ORDER BY s.secid, d.registry_close_date DESC

SELECT
    s.secid,
    sp.trade_date,
    sp.ratio_before,
    sp.ratio_after,
    CASE
        WHEN sp.ratio_after > sp.ratio_before THEN 'Сплит'
        WHEN sp.ratio_after < sp.ratio_before THEN 'Консолидация'
        ELSE 'Без изменения'
    END AS event_type,
    sp.ratio_after::numeric
        / NULLIF(sp.ratio_before, 0) AS split_ratio

FROM dwh.split AS sp

JOIN dwh.security AS s
    ON s.security_id = sp.security_id
